thread:
marco: Quick design review — thinking about moving the Export trace affordance in the request drilldown. Current placement feels buried in the overflow menu. Proposal: put a download icon next to the Correlation ID copy button. @elaine can you weigh in?
elaine: I'm down to move it up for discoverability but worried about accidental clicks. We should make it explicit in copy & tooltip and include filetype in aria label. Also, placement needs to respect the horizontal space at 320px containers. :thinking_face:
jia: From runtime side this is doable, but we need two things: (1) a size estimate for the trace to decide inline vs async export, (2) keyboard focus order so tabbing doesn't skip the copy button. If > ~5MB we should kick off async job and surface a link.
sam: Async job + progress UI seems necessary. For big exports we shouldn't block the UI thread. Also we should surface a notice about exporting PII if any redaction is enabled.
priya: Accessibility notes: aria-label should include the format and intent, e.g. `aria-label="Download trace snapshot as JSON (includes spans and events)"`. Tooltip alone isn't enough for screen reader users. Modal confirmation must trap focus and support Escape to close.
elaine: Microcopy thought — instead of generic 'Export' use 'Download trace snapshot (JSON)'. Tooltip: 'Download full trace as JSON'. Short, explicit. :white_check_mark:
alex: visually I prefer minimal icons: a clipboard icon for copy ID then a download icon for export, both with clear tooltips. If space is tight collapse into an overflow chevron that opens an actions menu (but less discoverable). I can mock both layouts.
jia: Another implementation detail: the copy and download buttons share handlers right now. If they sit adjacent we should separate click targets and aria-labels so assistive tech doesn't conflate them. Also will add telemetry flags: `trace_export_clicked` + `export_mode` (inline|async) + `format` (json|csv).
marco: Good call on telemetry. Also we should decide whether to offer multiple export formats. CSV for spans might be odd. Maybe offer 'JSON' and 'Plain text (stack + logs)'. Keep primary action as JSON.
priya: For keyboard-only users expose 'Download trace snapshot' as an item in the actions menu too (accessible via Enter/Space) and ensure SR announcement like 'Starting download, size estimation: ~200KB'.
marco: Small UX tweak: change ephemeral feedback from 'Copied!' to 'Correlation ID copied' so it's informative for screen reader history.
elaine: Two final variants for design review: (A) Inline download icon with size cap and modal for big traces, (B) Unified Actions chevron with both Copy ID and Download entries. I'll produce mocks for both and include the aria label examples. Can we get feasibility and telemetry acceptance from eng?
jia: Feasible. For (A) we add server-side size check and return `async_export_id` when oversized. For (B) simpler front-end change but slightly less discoverable. Telemetry seems fine.
sam: Ops note — async exports will need an S3 signed-url flow and retention policy. I'll pair with infra.
elaine: Example aria text to include in mocks: `aria-label="Download trace snapshot as JSON (trace length: 12 spans, size ~200KB)"`
marco: Thanks — @alex please drop the mocks into the design PR and @jia tag me when the API is ready. Priya, can you review the a11y annotations?
priya: Will review. Also recommend adding `role="status"` live region updates for export completion.
ops-bot: Reminder: deploy freeze starts 19:00 UTC today — flag any runtime migrations now.
marco: Noted. Thanks everyone — will loop back once mocks + API plan are up.
